questions.answer: Not easy. I had to find out everything on my own.

questions.answer: Off campus

questions.answer: very hard to find accommodation

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: that it is hard to find, and that you need to start searching in a good advance

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I had to select courses from the selection directed exchange students, but I found out on my own, that I could join every course on the website since the most courses anyway are teached in English

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Only the orientation counselor from Lund University, but also from CPH. But they often referred me to each other because there were no specific guidelines of who to answer what.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Pretty successful. Unless that i was at first only confirmed to 22,5 ECTS, which I found out during the sommer holiday which is when the counselors is on holiday, so i could not get any answers about that until right before arrival.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Remember that you can register for courses that are not part of the course selection for exchange students.

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: The level was higher, and there was expected more participation in the form of presentations and short assignments every week.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The level was higher, and there was expected more participation in the form of presentations and short assignments every week.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: very easy, but i guess it is because i am from Denmark.

questions.answer: Just try to visit the nations. Maybe try volunteering at the nations as well!

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: maybe that they were not that including, the Swedes.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: the fika concept!

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- appreaciate physical education at campus
- use your orientation counselor as much as you can, especially in the beginning
- join all the social events there are in the beginning

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Try to visit all campuses! they are all nice in their own ways

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Going to physical classes at campus, that I really enjoied.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: The online lessons
